name: Admin Block / Director's Office

name: Block 4

name: Block 5
description: Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering and Instrumentation & Control Engineering wings.

name: Old Academic Block (Block 6)

accessNote: Direct access via south entrance foyer facing Central Fountain.

description: Creative hub of NSUT featuring industrial design studios, ergonomics labs, rapid prototyping, and digital media suites.
